FOSSIL_STONE: A fossil of a Pokémon that lived in prehistoric times
OLD_AMBER: The holder gains the FOSSIL type
DAWN_STONE: The holder gains the PSYCHIC type
WATER_STONE: The holder gains the WATER type
THUNDER_STONE: The holder gains the ELECTRIC type
FIRE_STONE: The holder gains the FIRE type
MOON_STONE: The holder gains the FAIRY type
DUSK_STONE: The holder gains the DARK type
LEAF_STONE: The holder gains the GRASS type
ICE_STONE: The holder gains the ICE type
SOUL_DEW: During combat, the holder gains 5 AP and 5 PP every second
REAPER_CLOTH: The holder's ability can now critically strike based on CRIT_CHANCE. If the ability can already critically strike by default, increase CRIT_POWER by 50% instead.
POKEMONOMICON: When the holder deals SPECIAL, they BURN the target for 3 seconds and reduce its SPE_DEF by 1.
POWER_LENS: The amount of SPECIAL blocked by SPE_DEF is inflicted back to the attacker
SHELL_BELL: Holder heals for 33% of all damages inflicted
HEAVY_DUTY_BOOTS: Holder is immune to any BOARD_EFFECT, forced displacement and LOCKED
AQUA_EGG: The holder regains 20% of its max PP after casting its ability, + 2 PP for each cast done in the fight
BLUE_ORB: Every 3 attacks, unleashes a chain lightning that bounces to the 2 closest enemies, dealing 10 SPECIAL and burning 15 PP
SCOPE_LENS: Critical attacks steal 10 PP from the target ON_HIT.
STAR_DUST: After casting ability, gain 50% of max PP as SHIELD
GREEN_ORB: Holder and ADJACENT allies regain 5% of their max HP every 2 seconds. 30% of overheal is converted to PP.
DEEP_SEA_TOOTH: Holder restore 5 additional PP ON_ATTACK. If the attack knocks out the target, restore 15 additional PP.
SMOKE_BALL: Once below 40% max HP, drop the smoke ball, gain 70 SHIELD and jump to a tile away. Every ADJACENT enemy is PARALYSIS and BLINDED for 4 seconds.
XRAY_VISION: Holder is immune to SLEEP and their attacks can no longer miss.
RAZOR_FANG: Attacks apply ARMOR_BREAK for 2 seconds ON_HIT.
PROTECTIVE_PADS: Holder deals double damage against units with  SHIELD, and is protected from recoil damage and retaliation effects.
LOADED_DICE: Attacks have [50,LK]% chance to also hit the lowest health enemy ADJACENT to target for 75% of the damage, which also trigger ON_HIT effects.
PUNCHING_GLOVE: Attacks deal 8 % of target max HP as additional PHYSICAL ON_HIT
MUSCLE_BAND: When the holder takes damage, gain 1 stack. Every 2 stacks, the holder gains +2 DEF, +1 ATK and +5 SPEED (max 20 stacks)
WONDER_BOX: At the beginning of each battle, WONDER_BOX is replaced by 2 temporary random craftable items (max 3 items held)
ABILITY_SHIELD: When combat begins, the holder and allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW receive 20% of their max HP as SHIELD and SAFEGUARD for 5 seconds
STICKY_BARB: When struck by an attack at melee range, deal 3 + 15% of DEF as retaliation TRUE and inflict WOUND for 3 seconds to the attacker.
SAFETY_GOGGLES: Holder is immune to all negative status effects and to sandstorm damage
KINGS_ROCK: +100 HP. 20% of max HP are gained as SHIELD when combat begins.
SHINY_CHARM: Prevents damage and give PROTECT for 1.5 seconds and 50 PP the first time the holder gets below 30% HP
GRACIDEA_FLOWER: When combat begins, the holder and allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW gain +20 SPEED
FLAME_ORB: Holder increases its BASE ATK by 100% and is immune to FREEZE, but suffers from BURN during the entire fight.
ASSAULT_VEST: +40 SPE_DEF. Reduce BURN and POISONED damage by 50%
POKE_DOLL: Reduce all incoming PHYSICAL and SPECIAL by 30%. Makes the holder more likely to be targeted.
RED_ORB: 25% of attack damage is dealt as TRUE
MAX_REVIVE: Give RESURRECTION, preventing the holder first KO and restoring to max HP
ROCKY_HELMET: +25 DEF. Negates critical bonus damage from all incoming critical hits.
AGUAV_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, restore 50% HP and get CONFUSION for 3 seconds
APICOT_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 20 SPE_DEF
ASPEAR_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being FREEZE, heal 50 HP and give +15 SPEED and immunity to FREEZE for the rest of the fight
BABIRI_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP or after receiving a critical hit, heal 50 HP and gain PROTECT for 2 seconds
CHERI_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being PARALYSIS, heal 50 HP and give +10 ATK and immunity to PARALYSIS for the rest of the fight
CHESTO_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being SLEEP, heal 50 HP and give +50 AP and immunity to SLEEP for the rest of the fight
GANLON_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 20 DEF
JABOCA_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and cast $t(ability.SPIKY_SHIELD) for 10 seconds
LANSAT_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 50% CRIT_CHANCE
LEPPA_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP or after casting ability, heal 50 HP and gain 50 PP
LIECHI_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 15 ATK
LUM_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP, clear negative status and get SAFEGUARD for 5 seconds
ORAN_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 80 SHIELD
PECHA_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being POISONED, heal 100 HP and give immunity to POISONED for the rest of the fight
PERSIM_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being CONFUSION, heal 50 HP and give 10 SPE_DEF and immunity to CONFUSION for the rest of the fight
PETAYA_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 80 AP
RAWST_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being BURN, heal 50 HP and give 10 DEF and immunity to BURN for the rest of the fight
ROWAP_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and cast $t(ability.MAGIC_BOUNCE) for 10 seconds
SALAC_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 50 SPEED
SITRUS_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 100 HP and increase all healing received by 30%
NANAB_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and player gains 1 GOLD.
GOLDEN_PINAP_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50% of max HP and player gains 3 random SWEETS.
GOLDEN_RAZZ_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50% of max HP and player gains 6 free shop rerolls.
GOLDEN_NANAB_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50% of max HP and player gains 5 GOLD.
COMFEY: Wears $t(pkm.COMFEY) and get its ability and its max HP, ATK, DEF, and SPE_DEF as bonus stats.
ELECTIRIZER: Gives ELECTRIC synergy. Every third attack inflicts PARALYSIS for 2 seconds ON_HIT.
MAGMARIZER: Gives FIRE synergy. The holder doesn't take BURN damage. Instead, it gains 30 SPEED when burning.
DRAGON_SCALE: Gives DRAGON synergy as first synergy.
METRONOME: Gives SOUND synergy. Every second, the holder gains 5 PP.
AIR_BALLOON: Gives FLYING synergy. Gain 10% chance to dodge attacks and immunity to any BOARD_EFFECT.
EXPLORER_KIT: Gives GROUND synergy. Increase the [LK] chance to find gold buried in the ground.
INCENSE: Gives FLORA synergy. Each Pokémon in shop has an additional 5% chance to share a common synergy with the holder.
TERRAIN_EXTENDER: At the start of the fight, holder gains either ELECTRIC_FIELD, GRASS_FIELD, PSYCHIC_FIELD or FAIRY_FIELD based on its synergies. When casting its ability, spread the field effect to all allies sharing the field's synergy.
EXP_SHARE: Get the best ATK, AP, DEF and SPE_DEF values of allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW.
POKERUS_VIAL: Gives POISON synergy. Infects the holder with POKERUS, gaining 1 ATK and 10 AP every 3 seconds and transmitting to ADJACENT allies.
SPELL_TAG: Gives GHOST synergy. When the holder is KO, CURSE its attacker to be KO'd after 10 seconds
SHED_SHELL: Gives BUG synergy but reduce the holder's max HP by 50% when cloned.
BERSERK_GENE: Gives MONSTER synergy. The holder gets CONFUSION for 1 second if gaining MONSTER stacks.
SURFBOARD: Gives AQUATIC synergy. The holder casts $t(ability.SURF) at every TIDAL_WAVE, with the ability level matching current AQUATIC synergy level.
COOKING_POT: Gives GOURMET synergy. When BURN, the COOKING_POT is heated little by little which gives 10 SPEED per second.
RUNNING_SHOES: Gives FIELD synergy. The holder gains 5 SPEED every tile they move (jumps and dashes count for one tile).
MAX_ELIXIR: Restores 100% of max PP 1 second after the first ability cast.
METEORITE: A meteorite that seems to interact with Deoxys. It continues to give off a faint glow and is slightly warm to the touch.
ROTOM_CATALOG: A catalog of devices that Rotom like. Use the catalog to have Rotom hop in and out of the various devices listed within.
MYSTERY_BOX: A mysterious old box. When in your inventory, all $t(pkm.DITTO) found in shops are replaced by $t(pkm.MELTAN).
TRASH: No effect, but can be held.
OLD_ROD: After each PvP round, fish a Pokémon that is then added to a free slot on your bench. Can catch common and uncommon WATER Pokémon as well as $t(pkm.MAGIKARP).
GOOD_ROD: After each PvP round, fish a Pokémon that is then added to a free slot on your bench. Can catch rare WATER Pokémon as well as $t(pkm.FEEBAS).
SUPER_ROD: After each PvP round, fish a Pokémon that is then added to a free slot on your bench. Can catch epic WATER Pokémon as well as $t(pkm.WISHIWASHI).
DYNAMAX_BAND: At the start of the fight, raise max HP by 200%.
SHINY_STONE: Gives LIGHT synergy. A second spotlight is projected onto the holder's tile at the start of the fight.
RARE_CANDY: Immediately make a Pokémon evolve. Can only be given to Pokémon that can evolve, and reduce its sell price to its previous tier.
EVIOLITE: Holder gets a bunch of stats, but can no longer evolve. Can only be given to non-fully evolved Pokémon.
GOLD_MASK: At the start of the fight, spawn 3 Pokémon that share a type with the holder. Rarity and tier scale with stage level.
GOLD_BOTTLE_CAP: +1% CRIT_POWER per GOLD you have. Gain 1 GOLD per KO. If eliminating the last enemy, get a Jackpot that doubles the amount gained during the round.
ABSORB_BULB: All the damage reduction is absorbed by the bulb. Once under 50% HP, bulb explodes, dealing all damage absorbed to ADJACENT enemy units as SPECIAL.
SACRED_ASH: Gives RESURRECTION. After resurrecting, up to 3 allies KO are resurrected as well, but without items.
STAR_PIECE: Gives the holder one additional STAR, which increases the power of their ability.
REPEAT_BALL: Each time you spend gold on a reroll, gain 1 free reroll. For every 2 shop rerolls, gain 1 SPEED and 2 SHIELD. After lots of rerolls, you may encounter powerful Pokémon in your shop.
GOLD_BOW: The holder does not count for team size limit.
RED_SCALE: Increase your passive income by 5 GOLD per round
DAMP_ROCK: Counts for 3 towards RAIN. Under RAIN, your team gains +2 PP per second.
ICY_ROCK: Counts for 3 towards SNOW. Under SNOW, your team recovers from FREEZE 20% faster and have [5,LK]% additional chance to FREEZE their opponents with their attacks.
SUN_STONE: Counts for 3 towards ZENITH. Under ZENITH, your Pokémon heal for 5 HP every 2 seconds and have 5% additional chance to BURN with their attacks.
HEAT_ROCK: Counts for 3 towards DROUGHT. Under DROUGHT, your team gains 3 ATK and takes 20% less damage from BURN.
SMOOTH_ROCK: Counts for 3 towards SANDSTORM. Under SANDSTORM, your team takes 20% less sandstorm damage and gain 1 SPEED every second.
BLACK_AUGURITE: Counts for 3 towards NIGHT. Under NIGHT, your team gains 5% CRIT_CHANCE and take 10% less critical damage.
ELECTRIC_QUARTZ: Counts for 3 towards STORM. Under STORM, your team gains 50 SHIELD when struck by lightning and recovers from PARALYSIS 20% faster.
FLOAT_STONE: Counts for 3 towards WINDY. Under WINDY, your team gains 10 SPEED.
MIST_STONE: Counts for 3 towards MISTY. Under MISTY, your team gains 3 SPE_DEF.
BLOOD_STONE: Counts for 3 towards BLOODMOON. Under BLOODMOON, your team gets 30% of incoming healing as SHIELD when WOUND, and heal for 20% of damage dealt if target is WOUND.
SMELLY_CLAY: Counts for 3 towards SMOG. Under SMOG, your team gains 5% accuracy and has 15% less chance to get POISONED.
ODD_KEYSTONE: Counts for 3 towards MURKY. Under MURKY, your team gains 10 LUCK and -10% negative status duration, and resist to CURSE 1 second longer.
FIRE_SHARD: Sacrifice 3 player HP (1 in Double Up) to give permanently +3 ATK and +3 SPEED to a FIRE Pokémon. Immediately consumed when given.
CELL_BATTERY:
Each cell battery on bench gives 2 SPEED to all your ELECTRIC Pokémon.
Use it on an ELECTRIC Pokémon to supercharge it for the next fight, granting it 20 SPEED, 30 SHIELD and ELECTRIC_FIELD.
TEAL_MASK: This carved wooden mask is adorned with crystals, grants Ogerpon the FLORA type during battle. Ogerpon loses its mask when its shield is depleted.
WELLSPRING_MASK: This carved wooden mask is adorned with crystals, grants Ogerpon the AQUATIC type during battle. Ogerpon loses its mask when its shield is depleted.
HEARTHFLAME_MASK: This carved wooden mask is adorned with crystals, grants Ogerpon the FIRE type during battle. Ogerpon loses its mask when its shield is depleted.
CORNERSTONE_MASK: This carved wooden mask is adorned with crystals, grants Ogerpon the ROCK type during battle. Ogerpon loses its mask when its shield is depleted.
ZYGARDE_CUBE: Contains cells of the Order Pokémon, Zygarde. It will cause a transformation into one of its alternate formes.
TM: Teaches a HUMAN Pokémon a new ability and set its max PP to 100. Can only be used once.
CHEF_HAT: The holder will cook their Signature Dish between rounds. Dishes made are removed if the hat is removed.
PICNIC_SET: Immediately consumed when given. Give a SANDWICH to the holder and all ADJACENT allies. SANDWICH gives stat boosts for the next fight based on the types of the Pokémon eating it.
SANDWICH: Gives various stat boosts for the next fight based on the types of the Pokémon eating it.
HEARTY_STEW: At the start of next fight, raise max HP by 30%. If fed to a Pokémon holding COOKING_POT, the Pokémon is BURN for 5 seconds.
RAGE_CANDY_BAR: Gain 10 ATK at the start of the next fight.
TEA: Gain 60 PP at the start of the next fight.
CURRY: Start the next fight RAGE for 3 seconds.
CASTELIACONE: In the next fight, get [30,LK]% chance to inflict FREEZE for 2 seconds ON_HIT. The first attack always FREEZE.
WHIPPED_DREAM: In the next fight, get [30,LK]% chance to inflict CHARM for 2 seconds ON_HIT. The first attack always CHARM.
BLACK_SLUDGE: POISONED the Pokémon that eats it. If it has POISON type, restore 5% of max HP every 2 seconds instead. In the next fight, get [30,LK]% chance to inflict POISONED for 5 seconds ON_HIT. The first attack always inflicts POISONED.
BERRY_JUICE: Gain 100 SHIELD at the start of the next fight and every time a berry is consumed.
TART_APPLE: In the next fight, each attack by this Pokémon will remove 2 DEF from the target. Will turn into a SWEET_APPLE after one round.
SWEET_APPLE: In the next fight, each attack by this Pokémon will remove 2 SPE_DEF from the target. Will turn into a SIRUPY_APPLE after one round.
SIRUPY_APPLE: In the next fight, each attack by this Pokémon has [30,LK]% chance to inflict PARALYSIS for 1 second. Will turn into LEFTOVERS after one round.
HERBA_MYSTICA:
Gain a field effect based on its flavor. The flavor will be determined by the type of the Pokémon eating it:
FAIRY: HERBA_MYSTICA_SWEET
GRASS: HERBA_MYSTICA_BITTER
ELECTRIC: HERBA_MYSTICA_SOUR
PSYCHIC: HERBA_MYSTICA_SPICY
Others: HERBA_MYSTICA_SALTY
HERBA_MYSTICA_BITTER: Get GRASS_FIELD during the next fight
HERBA_MYSTICA_SALTY: Get SAFEGUARD during the next fight
HERBA_MYSTICA_SWEET: Get FAIRY_FIELD during the next fight
HERBA_MYSTICA_SPICY: Get PSYCHIC_FIELD during the next fight
HERBA_MYSTICA_SOUR: Get ELECTRIC_FIELD during the next fight
OLIVE_OIL: Gain 20% dodge chance in the next fight.
BERRIES: Forage a random berry for the Chef to hold. If no free item slots, it goes to your inventory.
POFFIN: Gain 100 SHIELD. All held berries are added to the poffin. Their effects are applied immediately, with healed HP turned into SHIELD.
HONEY: Each Pokémon in the next shop rerolls this round has an additional 5% chance to share a common synergy with a Pokémon eating HONEY.
MUSHROOMS: A mix of mushrooms that can be sold for GOLD when coming back to town
TINY_MUSHROOM: Gives 30 SPEED and reduce max HP by 30% for the next fight when consumed. Will be sold for 1 GOLD when returning to town.
BIG_MUSHROOM: Gives +30% max HP for the next fight when consumed. Will be sold for 2 GOLD when returning to town.
BALM_MUSHROOM: When consumed, gains SAFEGUARD, 30 SPEED and heals 10% of max HP per second for the next fight. Will be sold for 5 GOLD when returning to town.
RICE: Gives 50 additional max HP. If a Tatsugiri is on the board, also provides the additional stats given by its form.
ROCK_SALT: Start the next fight with SAFEGUARD for 10 seconds and 20% of max HP as SHIELD.
NUTRITIOUS_EGG: Start the next fight with +50% BASE ATK, DEF and SPE_DEF.
LEFTOVERS: No effect. There is not much left to eat.
BINDING_MOCHI: The first attack in the next fight will cause POSSESSED for 5 seconds ON_HIT.
FRUIT_JUICE: Gain 50 SPEED in the next fight.
LEEK: Gain 50% CRIT_CHANCE and allow ability to critically strike in the next fight. If the ability can already critically strike by default, increase CRIT_POWER by 50% instead.
LARGE_LEEK: Gain 100% CRIT_POWER and allow ability to critically strike in the next fight. If the ability can already critically strike by default, increase CRIT_POWER by 50% instead.
SPINDA_COCKTAIL: A cocktail with [LK] random effects that can buff stats or make you dizzy.
SMOKED_FILET: Permanently lose 5 max HP to gain 3 ATK and 10 AP.
SWEETS: A random candy granting a permanent stats bonus
VANILLA_FLAVOR: Baked with NORMAL FLYING ARTIFICIAL GOURMET allies. Use it on $t(pkm.MILCERY) to evolve into a $t(pkm.ALCREMIE_VANILLA). $t(passive_description.VANILLA_CREAM)
RUBY_FLAVOR: Baked with FIGHTING HUMAN STEEL allies. Use it on $t(pkm.MILCERY) to evolve into a $t(pkm.ALCREMIE_RUBY). $t(passive_description.RUBY_CREAM)
MATCHA_FLAVOR: Baked with GRASS FLORA POISON GHOST allies. Use it on $t(pkm.MILCERY) to evolve into a $t(pkm.ALCREMIE_MATCHA). $t(passive_description.MATCHA_CREAM)
MINT_FLAVOR: Baked with WATER AQUATIC ICE allies. Use it on $t(pkm.MILCERY) to evolve into a $t(pkm.ALCREMIE_MINT). $t(passive_description.MINT_CREAM)
LEMON_FLAVOR: Baked with ELECTRIC BUG FAIRY SOUND allies. Use it on $t(pkm.MILCERY) to evolve into a $t(pkm.ALCREMIE_LEMON). $t(passive_description.LEMON_CREAM)
SALTED_FLAVOR: Baked with ROCK GROUND FOSSIL allies. Use it on $t(pkm.MILCERY) to evolve into a $t(pkm.ALCREMIE_SALTED). $t(passive_description.SALTED_CREAM)
RUBY_SWIRL_FLAVOR: Baked with FIRE WILD FIELD allies. Use it on $t(pkm.MILCERY) to evolve into a $t(pkm.ALCREMIE_RUBY_SWIRL). $t(passive_description.RUBY_SWIRL_CREAM)
CARAMEL_SWIRL_FLAVOR: Baked with DARK MONSTER DRAGON allies. Use it on $t(pkm.MILCERY) to evolve into a $t(pkm.ALCREMIE_CARAMEL_SWIRL). $t(passive_description.CARAMEL_SWIRL_CREAM)
RAINBOW_SWIRL_FLAVOR: Baked with PSYCHIC AMORPHOUS BABY LIGHT allies. Use it on $t(pkm.MILCERY) to evolve into a $t(pkm.ALCREMIE_RAINBOW_SWIRL). $t(passive_description.RAINBOW_SWIRL_CREAM)
EGG_FOR_SELL: An Egg sold at Chansey's Daycare
AMULET_COIN:
+1 GOLD each time the holder knocks out an opponent.
Reduce max interest cap by 10 GOLD.
GIMMIGHOUL_COIN:
+5 GOLD when obtained.
Increase max interest cap by 10 GOLD.
COIN: An old rusty coin. +1 GOLD when obtained.
NUGGET: A small gold nugget. +3 GOLD when obtained.
BIG_NUGGET: A big gold nugget. +10 GOLD when obtained.
EXCHANGE_TICKET: Exchange an item component or a crafted item on bench for another random one. Single use, does not work with scarves.
RECYCLE_TICKET: Recycle a crafted item on bench or the crafted items held by a Pokémon into their BASE components. Then all components held are sent back to player item bench. Single use.
TREASURE_BOX: You wonder what's inside. It will open once you have 40 HP or less.
AUSPICIOUS_ARMOR: A peculiar set of armor that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. Auspicious wishes live within it.
MALICIOUS_ARMOR: A peculiar set of armor that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. Malicious will lurks within it.
RUSTED_SWORD: It is said that a hero used this sword to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. Gives the holder +50% BASE ATK. Transfers to the ally with the weakest ATK when the holder faints.
SCROLL_OF_WATERS: Written upon it are the true secrets of the path of water. When used on a $t(pkm.KUBFU), will cause it to evolve into $t(pkm.URSHIFU_RAPID).
SCROLL_OF_DARKNESS: Written upon it are the true secrets of the path of darkness. When used on a $t(pkm.KUBFU), will cause it to evolve into $t(pkm.URSHIFU_SINGLE)
RICH_MULCH: Use it on a flower pot to evolve the Pokémon inside, or on a berry tree to fully grow it.
AMAZE_MULCH: Use it on a flower pot to permanently give 50 max HP and 30 AP to the Pokémon inside, or on a berry tree to fully grow it and make it golden.
BRONZE_DOJO_TICKET: Use it on a Pokémon to send them to the Dojo for 3 stages, returning with +50 max HP, +5 ATK and +15 AP. A substitute takes their place in the meantime.
SILVER_DOJO_TICKET: Use it on a Pokémon to send them to the Dojo for 3 stages, returning with +100 max HP, +10 ATK and +30 AP. A substitute takes their place in the meantime.
GOLD_DOJO_TICKET: Use it on a Pokémon to send them to the Dojo for 3 stages, returning with +150 max HP, +15 ATK and +45 AP. A substitute takes their place in the meantime.

LEADERS_CREST: When another player beats you in battle, they get an additional 4 GOLD and take the LEADERS_CREST.
LAPRAS_PASSPORT: Lapras offers a ride to go to a different region. Use the passport on a Pokémon to influence the destination based on its synergies.
SILK_SCARF: Combine it with other item components to make all kinds of scarves, bands and bows. Those items will be removed if you lower down NORMAL synergy level.
FRIEND_BOW: The holder gains the NORMAL type.
BLACK_BELT: Critical attacks provide 33% of the damage dealt as SHIELD.
EXPLOSIVE_BAND: The first time user shield is depleted, this item explodes, dealing 50% of all SHIELD gained so far as SPECIAL to ADJACENT enemies.
TWIST_BAND: Stat debuffs inflicted by enemies become buffs instead. Holder stat buffs cannot be stolen.
BIG_EATER_BELT: Increase all stat buffs received by 25% (rounded down, not affecting PP). Allows the wearer to eat 2 different dishes per round.
LUCKY_RIBBON: Holder gets 20 LUCK and has [15,LK]% chance to dodge attacks.
COVER_BAND: If an ADJACENT ally is about to get KO with some incoming damage, the wearer takes the damage instead.
EFFICIENT_BANDANNA: The holder and allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW have their max PP reduced by 15%.
NULLIFY_BANDANNA: Holder can no longer cast its ability. AP is converted to ATK (5:1), and PP are converted to bonus SPECIAL on next attack.

PETRIFY_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT and have [5,LK]% chance to cause LOCKED for 2 seconds and reduce their DEF by 3.
SLOW_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT and have [5,LK]% chance to cause PARALYSIS for 2 seconds and reduce their SPEED by 10.
SLUMBER_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT and have [5,LK]% chance to cause SLEEP for 2 seconds and reduce their ATK by 3.
BLAST_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT, or 50% if it's a critical hit.
HP_SWAP_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT. Wands SPECIAL has [20,LK]% chance to be stolen from the target's max HP and given to the attacker.
SPIRIT_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT  + 5% for each ability casted by the attacker during the fight, and have [20,LK]% chance to give 5 additional PP.
LONG_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT . Ranged FAIRY allies gain +1 RANGE and have [1,LK]% increased CRIT_CHANCE, multiplied by the distance between attacker and target.
GUIDING_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT . Wands SPECIAL has [50,LK]% chance to be redirected to the lowest HP% enemy at RANGE.
SURROUND_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT + 5% per enemy ADJACENT to the attacker. Wands SPECIAL has [10,LK]% chance to be inflicted to all enemies ADJACENT to the attacker in addition to the target.
POUNCE_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT . When being hit at melee range, FAIRY allies have [10,LK]% chance to retaliate for 30% of incoming damage to ADJACENT enemies, guaranteed if it's a critical hit.
TWO_EDGED_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 50% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT. Wands SPECIAL can also be inflicted as recoil damage to the attacker ([80,LK]% chance to prevent recoil damage).
WARP_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT and have [5,LK]% chance to teleport target on a cell far away
SWITCHER_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT and have [5,LK]% chance to swap target position with farthest enemy
WHIRLWIND_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT and have [5,LK]% chance to throw a whirlwind that makes all the units in its path to fly away.
TUNNEL_WAND: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT. Wands SPECIAL has [5,LK]% chance to pass through the target to hit enemies in a line behind it.
